card.name: Survey results reported as percentages
card.fires_on: Words in sentences that report survey or trial percentages, such as 'admitted keeping', 'leftover drugs', 'most common reasons', or 'those surveyed agreed'. It fires on the word right after the group or category being counted.

modes.label: Survey respondent behavior
modes.description: Verb or noun just after a percentage of people who did or said something.
modes.example: they do not discard these drugs because 44% of those with leftover antimicrobial drugs admitted<< keeping>> them in case of future need.

modes.label: Most common reasons or events
modes.description: Noun after 'most common' or 'most important' that names a category of causes or events.
modes.example: Menstrual changes were the most common medical<< reason>> for discontinuation of Paragard.

modes.label: Listed frequent reactions
modes.description: Item in a list of most common adverse reactions with rates.
modes.example: The most common infusion reactions (≥ 1%) were pyrexia, chills,<< fatigue>>, headache, asthenia, hypers

card.writes: It pushes toward survey wording such as 'respondents', 'surveyed' and 'prevalence'.
card.plain: It marks spots in text where a share of people or cases is being described, as in survey results.
